assertion: Patterns repeat vector contents in user and object bounding box coordinates, fit a viewBox, transform and inherit referenced tiles, and paint fills and strokes.

browser.reason: Three browsers agree on tile geometry, offsets, viewBox letterboxing and stroke coverage. Reviewed actual and difference images: 2447 changed pixels lie on shape contours, maximum 40 channels. Explicit child fill avoids the documented SVG 2 shadow-inheritance browser discrepancy.
